## Introduction

In this course we covered programming languages and the basic constructs of a program. This page includes practice problems on machine language, compilers vs. interpreters, paradigms, and sequence, selection and repetition.

## How To Use This Page

For each problem, use the **↻ New variant** button to generate a new problem of that type. Use the **Check** button to check your answer. Use the **Show answer** button to see the answer and an explanation.

[Review the lesson](../../lessons/02%20Introduction%20to%20Computer%20Programming/index.qmd){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
